_meta.source_dir: production-source/video/en/ of the GHCP_CLI_Demo_Kit working copy (English recording of the ghcp_cli_workflow_demo_kit scenario)
_meta.encoding: libx264 slow crf21 high@4.1 yuv420p +faststart -an, 30 fps, 1880x968, fade-in 0.25 s, fade-out 0.35 s, -threads 2
_meta.method: frame-exact trim / integer decimation (2x,3x) / concatenation of source frames; no overlay, crop, scale or re-render. Every segment verified against its source frames (PSNR 44-52 dB).
_meta.note: All times are seconds. 'out' = time in the finished clip, 'src' = time in the source file. Ranges in key_moments were measured on the FINAL clips (+-0.2 s). Posters are PNG 1880x968 taken at poster_time.

facts.text: Copilot CLI 'Custom Agents' picker lists the workflow agents (app-developer, change-analyst, code-reviewer, ops-analyst, qa-engineer, release-manager, solution-architect); change-analyst is chosen. Caption: 'The business change request goes to the Change Analyst agent'.
Prompt typed to change-analyst is complete and sent: 'Analyze the impact of change request CR-2026-014 (docs/requirements/CR-2026-014.md).'

Caption 'Reading code, docs and real data to find the impact (waiting time is sped up)' with an '8x speed' badge: Read lines for CR-2026-014.md, standards, refund_service.py, schemas.py, 001_init.sql, main.py...; read-only 'sqlite3 -readonly ... data/orders.db' queries; agent states the main risk (mobile 3.1-3.3 send only an amount, mixed VIP spellings, deploy script stops the service).

Final summary: 'Saved: docs/cr/CR-2026-014/01-impact-analysis.md' - impact spans API, refund rules, database, web, notifications, policy, tests and operations; local data has mixed VIP spellings (five delivered orders enter the extended window); key risks; Decision 1 and Decision 2 for a human. Caption: 'Analysis done - impact, data anomalies and decisions needed are summarized'.

facts.text: Request typed to solution-architect: 'Design this based on the impact analysis. Ask me about any decisions that need to be made.' Caption: 'The Solution Architect agent designs it and asks a human about key decisions'.

Decision 1 (amber bar 'Human approval needed - A human decides'): 'How should legacy mobile apps handle mandatory refund reasons? I recommend enforcing reasons at activation...' with options 'Enforce reasons at activation...', 'Stage mobile updates before enforcing reasons...', 'Other (type your answer)'. The human later picks Other and types: 'Allow legacy app versions (3.1-3.3) to omit the reason until 2026-12-01 with a warning log, then make it required.' (full answer readable 19.2-21.6).

Gate 1: 'Hook permission request - Design approval: Have you reviewed the design document (docs/cr/CR-2026-014/02-design.md)? Approving starts the implementation phase, and if the design changes after approval, the approval is automatically invalidated.' Caption: 'The system requires approval - if the design changes after approval it is automatically invalidated'. Decisions 2 (VIP tier normalization) and 3 (User-Agent allowlist + 2026-12-01 cutoff) were answered with the recommended options earlier (22.0-28.8).

'Design saved in docs/cr/CR-2026-014/02-design.md and approved by Gildong Hong (Ops Lead) ... Design approval complete -> next stage: app-developer'. Caption: 'Design approved - code changes are now allowed'.
